scope: same frozen four-row Down KB1 cold sample, same single-beat 512-bit AXI q0/q1 ports and TB RVALID periodic profile; read-only interpretation; no new DUT/candidate/tool

source_rules.AXI_R_handshake: one 512-bit beat maximum per port per cycle
source_rules.reader: single-burst ISSUE/RECV; RREADY throughout RECV; strict full-length reads
source_rules.model: same actual q0/q1/scale beat counts and no change to TB response profile

derived.calculation: For 20992 accepted R beats and at most 4 RVALID cycles per 5 consecutive cycles, earliest possible span with favorable phase is 26239 cycles. Observed active beats+gaps=26240.

judgment: Under this declared same-response cold scope, W reader scheduling by itself has at most about 825 cycles idealized room, before validity/retirement overhead. It is not a promise that 825 cycles are removable. Higher impact would require a different memory service or reuse/overlap boundary and its own same-profile baseline. KB1 command path 16183 cycles remains a measured priority for next same-scope candidate.
limits: Assumes one R beat per 512-bit q port per cycle; preserves all 20992 beats on each q port and fixed TB RVALID every fifth cycle unavailable.
Does not claim that actual HBM has this periodic profile.
Does not prove warm W reuse, compute/load overlap, or reader redesign safe.
Exclusive phase relationship across redesigned DUT is unknown; cold-TB bound assumes other measured phases unchanged.
